The output is high quality in content (all 135 file blocks complete with 4 sections, functional module names for 8/10 modules, specific dependency citations, correct INDEX assembly) but has three concrete gaps, all agent execution failures rather than Skill defects: (1) Coverage stopped at 72.58% — the infrastructure pseudo-module was never documented despite the Skill's HARD STOP gate; (2) Two large modules (scrapy-__main__, scrapy-scraper) were generated without YAML front matter, deviating from the DOC_TEMPLATES.md format; (3) Phase 4 module renaming was incomplete — the same two modules retained their module_id as headings.
